objectives.title: Return to the village
objectives.description: Follow the mountain road into the village and reach the post office.

objectives.title: Speak to Gopinath Sahu at the post office
objectives.description: Gopinath has news of Prakash and a package left for you.

objectives.title: Inspect Prakash's package
objectives.description: Examine the photograph and message inside the package.

objectives.title: Follow the first lead
objectives.description: [PROVISIONAL — destination pending approval (Story Register S-02).] Follow the lead from Prakash's package to the first investigation location.
